title: One Minute, Forty Seconds Behind
sub: RULE: TWO MINUTES OR FOUR NAUTICAL MILES · ACTUAL: AT LEAST 4.3 NM AND 3,800 FT · NTSB FINDING THREE: THE CONTROLLER COMPLIED
imageCredit: N14053 BEFORE TAKEOFF, JFK, 12 NOV 2001 · CONSTRUCTION-SITE CAMERA · NTSB DOCKET · PUBLIC DOMAIN
_facts: CLAIMS-american587.md ANCHORS: c17 liftoff 0914:29; c18 1 min 40 s behind JAL 47 (AAR p.3); c19 heavy-behind-heavy rule 2 min OR 4 nm (AAR fn 9); c20 actual separation at least 4.3 nm / 3,800 ft (fn 11); Finding 3 'the controller complied' (CLAIMS correction #5).
